text.p: Tropical Cyclone Ophelia, with 65 mph winds, is south of Java in the Southeast Indian Ocean near 11.9s/110.4e, moving southeast at 10 mph. Ophelia will continue on a southerly to southeasterly track. Top winds should reach 80 mph by 48 hours as the system becomes a major threat to shipping. It is a few days away from the coast of Northwest Australia, should it take the track it is expected to take.

Tropical Depression 41W is in the far Southern South China sea near 4n/110e, moving east-northeast at 6 mph. Top winds are near 30 mph and should change little during the next 36 hours. This system will be a moderate threat to shipping but it no threat to major land areas at this time.
